G3652.name: Olympas
G3652.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3652.short: Olympas was a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

G3682.name: Onesimus
G3682.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3682.short: Onesimus was a runaway slave who became a Christian through Paul's ministry and was the subject of Paul's letter to Philemon.

G3683.name: Onesiphorus
G3683.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G3683.short: Onesiphorus was a friend of Paul who often refreshed him and was not ashamed of his imprisonment.
